newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -J.P. Morgan ups Allegheny EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -J.P. Morgan ups Allegheny EPS.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities steel analyst Mike Gambardella said he raised his full-year '97 estimate on Allegheny Teledyne Inc to $1.80 from $1.70.
-- Gambardella said he also raised his '98 estimate on Allegheny Teledyne to $2.10 from $1.90.
-- Gambardella said the revised estimates reflect "the improvement in non-stainless steel operating margins."
-- The company on Wednesday posted fourth quarter earnings of $0.40 per share before unusual items.
-- "(The company's) ability to report strong fourth quarter earnings despite generally weak stainless steel prices is why we consider it our top pick in the steel group," Gambardella said.
-- Gambardella said last year's merger between Teledyne Inc and Allegheny Ludlum Corp produced "a financially strong company that enjoys a diversified earnings base."
